C1373.title: Hangzhou Counterfeit imToken Wallet Cryptocurrency Theft Case
C1373.summary: In the first half of 2021, Hangzhou police dismantled a case involving a counterfeit 'imToken' virtual currency wallet app used to illegally obtain users' mnemonic phrases. The criminal group induced users to download the fake wallet and import their seed phrases, thereby stealing virtual currency assets.
